title: 7 Best Herbal Essential Oils For Gallstones
intro: Herbal essential oils for gallstones are a natural remedy that involves using highly concentrated plant extracts to alleviate symptoms and promote healing of the gallbladder. These oils have been found to offer numerous benefits in treating gallstones, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and dissolving gallstones. Examples of herbal essential oils used to treat gallstones include peppermint oil, which helps to relax the muscles and improve bile flow; ginger oil, which reduces inflammation and promotes healing; and turmeric oil, which contains curcumin that has anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. Additionally, other beneficial oils for gallstones treatment include lemon oil, which stimulates digestion and liver function, and frankincense oil, which reduces inflammation and promotes healing of the gallbladder.

preparations.preparation_desc: Curcuma longa essential oils have been traditionally used to treat gallstones ailment due to their anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents, such as curcumin, demethoxycurcumin, and bisdemethoxycurcumin, in Curcuma longa essential oils exhibit choleretic and spasmolytic properties, thereby facilitating the removal of gallstones. By incorporating Curcuma longa essential oils into one's treatment plan, individuals can benefit from reduced inflammation, improved digestive health, and a lower risk of complications associated with gallstones.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Alimentary pharmacology & therapeutics", Curcuma longa essential oils for gallstones may be beneficial as curcumin induces contraction of the human gall-bladder, reducing gall-bladder volume by up to 29.3% after 2 hours of administration.
